hero.subtitle: Industrial solutions in steel and engineering plastics for material processing, load protection and logistics efficiency — from the production line to the final destination.

about.introHighlight: steel processing, engineering plastics and protection systems
about.introAfter: to optimize industrial operations with coils, sheets and critical materials.

solutions.title: Industrial solutions for processing and protection
solutions.subtitle: Dutex operates at both ends of the operation. It delivers processed material ready for production. And protects the load from the point of origin to the production line.

items.title: Steel Processing
items.description: Steel processed with industrial precision — coils, custom sheets, slitter and blanks in ZC, FF and FQ with thicknesses up to 40mm. Raw material ready for your production.

items.title: Engineering Plastics
items.description: Industrial components in virgin or recycled PP by injection (240 to 650 ton) and extrusion. Corner protectors, separators and protectors with high impact absorption.

items.title: Protection and Logistics
items.description: Cradles for coils from 3 to 20 tons, sleeves, collars, elastomeric protectors and honeycomb protectors. Protection from the production line to the final destination.

whyDutex.title: Why Dutex?
whyDutex.intro: Dutex manufactures internally with a complete structure — full control over quality, lead time and customization, without relying on third parties. Customized solutions for each client and load type.

items.title: Engineering applied to operations
items.subtitle: Not an off-the-shelf product. Each solution is designed for the client's reality.

items.title: Integrated steel + plastic production
items.subtitle: Complete vertical integration: materials, engineering, operations and logistics in a single company.

items.title: Traceability and control
items.subtitle: Dimensional control in every batch with ISO 9001:2015 certification.

items.title: 100% in-house manufacturing
items.subtitle: Plastic injection, PP extrusion and metal fabrication — without relying on third parties.

applications.subtitle: Many Dutex solutions were born from specific needs of industrial clients. The company analyzes the problem, develops the engineering, designs the tools and manufactures internally.

items.title: Leader in the steel sector
items.subtitle: Co-extruded Plastic Corner Protector
items.description: A major player in the national steel industry approached Dutex seeking a protection solution for metallic materials. They brought a reference and asked if it would be possible to develop something similar.
steps: Reverse engineering analysis of the reference product
Adaptation of the co-extrusion process with non-woven fabric (TNT)
items.result: The result was the co-extruded plastic corner protector with non-woven fabric, now used in the operations of various clients. This project paved the way for Dutex's entire line of logistics products.

items.title: Major industrial player
items.subtitle: Vertical integration of imported product
items.description: An industry used a component imported from Korea. They brought a sample and asked if it would be possible to manufacture the product in Brazil.
steps: Reverse engineering of the imported product
Industrialization and domestic production of the component
items.result: Dutex vertically integrated domestic production of this component, eliminating import dependency and reducing costs and delivery time.

items.title: Solar energy sector
items.subtitle: Special PP profile for solar energy
items.description: A company in the solar energy sector presented a profile found in Europe for signaling and cable protection in solar plants. They asked if Dutex could develop it in Brazil.
items.result: The product is now used in solar energy generation projects in Brazil.

process.subtitle: A structured technical process to transform operational needs into reliable, durable industrial solutions applicable to logistics reality.

items.title: Technical diagnosis
items.description: Detailed analysis of the application, load type, operational environment and risks involved in transport, handling and storage.

items.title: Engineering and design
items.description: Reverse engineering or development from scratch — definition of materials, geometries and production tools according to operational needs.

items.title: Production and validation
items.description: Manufacturing, functional tests and delivery with quality control, traceability and compliance with industrial standards.

contact.title: Let's talk about your project?
contact.description: Speak with Dutex's sales team for quotes, technical specifications or custom solutions in steel and engineering plastics.

testimonials.title: Reliability for industrial operations
testimonials.subtitle: We serve industries with high technical requirements, where logistics failures are not an option.

items.quote: Dutex's cradles significantly reduced damage during coil transport. Applied engineering for our operation made all the difference — it's not an off-the-shelf product.
items.author: Carlos Mendes

items.quote: We brought a sample of an imported component and Dutex verticalized national production. We eliminated import dependency and reduced costs and delivery time.
items.author: Fernanda Oliveira

items.quote: Steel and plastic integration in a single supplier simplified our entire chain. Traceability, dimensional control and on-time delivery — Dutex delivers on its promise.
